create_AddTargetDataset: create an AddTargetDataset wrapper that attaches labels to a Fairseq dataset with padding and EOS tokens
use_get_label: use the get_label method to retrieve a processed or raw label by index from the dataset
use_getitem: use the __getitem__ method to fetch a dataset item with its corresponding label attached
use_collater: use the collater method to batch samples and collate target tokens with optional sequence lengths
use_size: use the size method to get the combined size of a dataset item and its label length
